as_told.title: Chase Brandon's novel: committee with a crystal tablet showing future timelines

plain: A document Michels calls the Kryptos Conundrum, which he links to a former CIA officer named Chase Brandon, describes a secret intelligence committee that manages humanity's future, and the beings behind it are said to "paranormally show up to everybody on the committee like independently and coordinate them together." Michels tells this himself in two episodes. In the later one he adds a detail: the committee had "a crystal tablet that gave them access to reading future timelines," which would mean someone outside humanity is steering events and letting a small group see what is coming.
